codeReview.summary: RE-REVIEW of commit 6c9de0d (the correct embedding commit). The prior review incorrectly examined commit 635d1a3 (API key encryption) due to a metadata error in the handoff. Commit 6c9de0d correctly implements the full vector embedding pipeline: rewrites OllamaEmbeddings to use direct HTTP API, adds provider selection with Ollama→OpenAI→NullEmbeddings priority, fixes SQL CAST syntax for asyncpg, implements graceful NullEmbeddings fallback with single-warning, and includes 32 comprehensive pytest tests. All 5 expectedBehavior items are satisfied. The implementation is clean, well-structured, and follows existing codebase patterns.

issues.description: _openai_key_works() makes a synchronous HTTP call to api.openai.com during get_embedding_provider(). Since this runs at app startup (not in the async event loop yet), it works correctly, but it blocks for up to 10 seconds if OpenAI is slow. Not a bug — just a minor design note. The Ollama path (primary) doesn't hit this.

OllamaEmbeddings._normalize_dim() pads 768-dim nomic-embed-text vectors to 1536 with trailing zeros. This preserves relative cosine similarity between vectors (all padded equally), but wastes ~50% of the pgvector column storage. Not a correctness issue — just a potential future optimization to change EMBEDDING_DIM to match the actual model's native dimension.

Feature description mentioned 'Update the embedding provider in core/memory/context.py', but context.py correctly delegates to MemoryManager (which uses the embedding pipeline). No changes needed in context.py — the fix was correctly placed in embeddings.py and manager.py where the actual embedding logic lives.
